newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama grants asylum to Ecuador's deposed leader.
newsitem.headline: Panama grants asylum to Ecuador's deposed leader.

text.p: Panama has granted political asylum to Ecuador's deposed President Abdala Bucaram, the Foreign Ministry said on Monday.
"The government of Panama has given political asylum to Bucaram, his wife, children and brother, effective last Thursday," spokesman Erich Rodriguez said.
Bucaram was deposed by Ecuador's Congress on Feb. 6 on grounds of "mental incompetence", after only six months in power, and came to Panama a few days later.
He had lived in Panama from 1985 to 1990 afer fleeing charges of corruption as mayor of his home city Guayaquil.
